QuestInfo.parent: Where in Maple World is Chromile the Knight?

0.0: There have to be more diary pages, but the Dark Stumps don't seem to have them... I should try some other monsters.

yes.0: Investigate the #bAxe Stumps#k on the #bMini Rocky Road#k and #bBig Rocky Road#k.

no.0: I don't think the Dark Stumps have much on them anymore... Maybe it's time to investigate other monsters.

1.0: Father's handwriting is atrocious, but I think I can make it out... \r\n#b'Day 27...\nShe's gone. She's gone, but my baby is safe, just like she wanted. I feel numb. I can still see her face every time I close my eyes. I feel like I could just close my eyes forever so that I don't have to see this world any more. Nothing matters anymore. There's no light without her. There's just nothing...'
1.1: Mother wanted to protect me, that was her wish. Father respected her decision and now he's lost to darkness. He didn't give her away. He didn't give up on her. He let her make the choice.
